meta.title: An RFQ→Auction conversion bypasses the savings-mandatory check
gaps: The available operations cannot set or remove a savings entry, so the no-savings input cannot be explicitly represented.
The app's error code for the mandatory-savings refusal is not provided.
The plan depends on the isSavingsConfigurationMandatory setting.
the case reads as “it is accepted”, but the plan checks “it is refused”
it depends on a company setting this run does not change (isSavingsConfigurationMandatory) — a failure is reported as couldn't tell, not as a bug

words.preconditions: A fresh draft event with one line item and an RFQ (pricing) round attached, not published.
steps: The buyer converts the pricing round into a live auction.
As the buyer, read the event and check that the event is still a draft (not published).
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with a clear message, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: the event is still a draft (not published).

plan.title: An RFQ→Auction conversion bypasses the savings-mandatory check

assert.say: the event is still a draft (not published)
